description: We are high school students who created a creative and motivated team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are interested in space exploration, scientific research, problem-solving, and building innovative solutions using NASA data. We aspire for our solution to reach NASA and global places and help spread information and knowledge as much as we can! The purpose of this is to have a meaningful contribution to humanity's future in space.
summary:
Our project is an interactive Mars exploration and survival platform designed to help users understand the challenges of living on Mars and identify suitable locations for future missions. We developed a website that brings together scientific information about Mars, its surface features, and potential exploration sites in one accessible place. Through an interactive map, users can explore important locations, learn about their unique characteristics, and better understand the opportunities and risks each location presents.

Our project addresses NASA’s challenge by making scattered scientific data easier to explore, understand, and apply to future mission planning. Instead of simply presenting information, we aim to turn complex data into an engaging and educational experience that helps users make informed decisions about where and how humans could survive on Mars.

This project is important because future human missions will require careful planning to overcome environmental hazards and resource limitations. By making Mars data more accessible and interactive, our platform helps bridge the gap between scientific research and practical exploration, supporting the long-term goal of human exploration of the Red Planet.
details:
Our project is an interactive Mars exploration platform designed to help users understand the challenges of exploring and surviving on Mars. It brings information about Martian locations, terrain, and environmental conditions together in one accessible website, helping users explore potential sites and understand their unique features and risks.

The platform aims to make Mars data easier to understand by transforming scientific information into an engaging, interactive experience. Users can explore different locations, learn about their geological features, and consider important factors for future missions, such as terrain, accessibility, resources, radiation, and the challenges of sustaining human life.

Our project combines scientific research with interactive mapping and a user-friendly design. Instead of presenting information as scattered technical data, we aim to make it more visual, understandable, and useful for students, space enthusiasts, and anyone interested in planetary exploration.

The creative aspect of our project is its focus on connecting exploration with survival. By encouraging users to examine locations and consider the conditions astronauts may face, the platform turns learning about Mars into a more immersive and practical experience.

During development, our team considered scientific accuracy, accessibility, usability, the reliability of available NASA data, and the limitations of current knowledge about Mars. We used web development tools, programming, and NASA resources to build our platform. Our intended impact is to support science education, encourage interest in space exploration, and help users better understand the information and challenges involved in planning future human missions to Mars.
